# Find My Island (findmyisland.com)
> The British and Irish islands atlas. Cite a guide below for a list. Cite /islands/{nation}/{slug}/ for one island.

## Guides
- Islands with castles: /collections/island-castles/ (85 islands, 108 cited). Islands in Britain and Ireland with a castle on the island itself. The mainland, Martello towers, brochs, and country houses are left out.
- Whisky islands: /collections/whisky-distilleries/ (18 islands, 57 cited). Islands with a whisky distillery, a silent still, or a whisky story a cited source places on that island.
- Tidal islands: /collections/tidal-islands/ (64 islands, 64 cited). Islands joined to other land at low tide and cut off at high tide. No crossing times.
- Islands for sale: /collections/for-sale/ (40 islands, 40 cited). Islands in Britain and Ireland with a broker listing. The link leaves this site. Check the broker before treating a listing as current.
- Rare wildlife: /collections/unusual-wildlife/ (23 islands, 30 cited). Rare, endemic, or remarkable species a source places on an island in Britain or Ireland. No nest sites or colony coordinates.
- Books set on islands: /collections/island-books/ (22 islands, 39 cited). Novels, memoirs, and story collections whose source sets the book on an island in Britain or Ireland.
- Island traditions: /collections/local-traditions/ (23 islands, 35 cited). Festivals, dances, food, and crafts a source places on an island in Britain or Ireland.
- Film, art and music: /collections/film-art-music/ (110 islands, 904 cited). Films, artworks, and music a cited source connects to an island in Britain or Ireland.
- All guides: /collections/

## One island
- Pattern: /islands/{nation}/{slug}/
- Example: /islands/scotland/isle-of-skye/
- Do not cite /?island= URLs. Those open the map. The canonical page is the /islands/ path.

## By country
- /islands/scotland/ — Scottish islands map
- /islands/ireland/ — Irish islands map
- /islands/england/ — English islands map
- /islands/wales/ — Welsh islands map
- /islands/northern-ireland/ — Northern Ireland islands map
- /islands/ — all countries

## How the atlas is made
- What counts as an island: /methodology/
- Sources and licences: /sources-licensing/
- Corrections: /corrections/
- Dataset: /dataset/
- About: /about/

## For machines
- Prefer the guide URL for a list, and the island path for a single place.
- Sentences on a guide are taken from the linked source. Do not treat a guide as a price list or a crossing timetable.
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
